start.text:
Welcome to Hydra Monitors payment bot.

Support: {support_url}
buy.title: Choose a tariff:
buy.duration.title: Choose a duration:
buy.invoice.created: Invoice created. Use the payment button below to complete your purchase.
buy.invoice.failed: Could not create invoice. Please try again or contact support.
start.trial.cta: New here? Start a free {days}-day trial — no payment required.
trial.confirm.text:
Start your free {days}-day trial now?

Access opens immediately, and you can use it only once.
trial.success.text: Your free trial is active for {days} days (until {expires_at}). Access links are on the way.
trial.already_used: You have already used your free trial.
trial.has_active: You already have an active subscription.
trial.unavailable: The free trial is not available right now.
promo.prompt: Send /promo <code> to apply a promo code.
promo.applied: Promo code {code} will be applied to your next invoice.
promo.enter: Send your promo code as a message:
promo.error.exhausted: Promo code usage limit has been reached.
promo.error.tariff_not_allowed: Promo code is not available for this tariff.
promo.error.already_used: You have already used this promo code.
referral.start.rebind_rejected: Referral is already set and cannot be changed.
payment.success.text: Payment received. Your access has been activated.
access.empty.text: Access chats are not configured yet. Please contact support: {support_url}
notification.3d.text:
Your subscription expires soon: {expires_at}.

Renew access in the bot or contact support: {support_url}
notification.0d.text:
Your subscription has expired: {expires_at}.

Access will be revoked soon unless you renew. Support: {support_url}
notification.post.text:
Access has been revoked after subscription expiration: {expires_at}.

You can renew any time in the bot. Support: {support_url}
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
grant.success: Granted access to user {user_id} for {days} days. Expires at {expires_at}.
refset.forbidden: Only admins can set referral percent.
refset.success: Referral percent for user {user_id} set to {percent}%. Updated links: {updated}.
refset.success.future: Referral percent for user {user_id} set to {percent}%. Future referrals will use it.
broadcast.private_only: Open the broadcast in a private chat with the bot.
admin.panel.title: Admin panel. Choose an action.
admin.grant.prompt:
Send the user id and number of days, separated by a space.
Example: 123456789 30
admin.grant.invalid: Invalid input. Send: user_id days (both positive integers).
admin.refset.prompt:
Send the user id and percent (0 to 99), separated by a space.
Example: 123456789 10
admin.refset.invalid: Invalid input. Send: user_id percent (0 to 99).
admin.promo.title: Active promo codes:
admin.promo.duplicate: A promo with this code already exists. Send a different code.
admin.promo.new.value: Send the value (percent, USD, or days depending on the type).
admin.promo.new.max_uses: Send the max number of uses, or Skip for unlimited.
admin.promo.new.expires: Send the expiry date as YYYY-MM-DD, or Skip for none.
admin.promo.new.expires_invalid: Invalid or past date. Use YYYY-MM-DD.
admin.promo.new.tariffs: Select the allowed tariffs, or Done to allow all.
stats.title: Statistics — {period}
